blocks.heading: Practice Rounds Before the Interview
rows: A stranger can repeat your story back accurately after one hearing. Field check: task, learning and next step.
Say it aloud under a minute.
You finish in about a minute and it sounds like you, not a script. Field check: calm and short.
Your answer to the question you fear holds up without notes.
You keep the same facts when a follow-up changes the angle. Field check: steady on rules and AI.

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: Keep spending on an international business course near 10 percent of your total education budget and treat 20 percent as a caution. Illustration, not a real fee: from 8 lakh, about 80,000 goes to formal study and the rest stays for living costs, practice and later learning.
